name: pop.tfr_target
justification: Bracket between very low observed fertility and replacement level (2.1); family triangular chosen as least informative bounded distribution.

name: pop.kappa_f
justification: Fitted to the 1990-2005 fertility path; sensitivity range 0.02 to 0.10.

name: pop.e0_max
justification: Asymptote of life expectancy; parsimonious single-level parameter with sensitivity range 85 to 90 years.

name: pop.kappa_e
justification: Spread of life_expectancy_at_birth variants once loaded; family triangular chosen as least informative bounded distribution.

name: pop.mig_rate
justification: Wide bracket around zero because no verified historical series exists; family triangular chosen as least informative bounded distribution.

name: gro.alpha
justification: Usual bracket for capital share in growth accounting literature; sensitivity range 0.30 to 0.45.

name: gro.delta
justification: Bracket for annual depreciation rate of mixed physical capital; sensitivity range 0.03 to 0.08.

name: gro.rho
justification: Weak positive co-movement between TFP growth and investment rate to avoid independent extremes; sensitivity range 0.0 to 0.5.

name: gro.s
justification: Bracket for investment rate as fraction of core GDP; family triangular chosen as least informative bounded distribution.

name: gro.gA
justification: Scenario driver; dispersion set from forecast_vintages errors, location from base_rates; family triangular chosen as least informative bounded distribution.

name: hdi.educ_target
justification: Long-run education index target asymptote; sensitivity range 0.85 to 1.00.

name: hdi.kappa_educ
justification: Speed of education index convergence; sensitivity range 0.01 to 0.05.

name: res.pi_a
justification: Base rate intercept of project reaching production by stage; requires empirical research source on historical mining and energy project advancement.

name: res.pi_b
justification: Slope of project advancement probability per stage rank; requires empirical research source.

name: res.delay
justification: Project start delay beyond announced start year; family triangular chosen as least informative bounded distribution.

name: res.util
justification: Utilization rate after production ramp-up; family triangular chosen as least informative bounded distribution.

name: res.ramp
justification: Linear ramp-up duration from first production to plateau capacity; sensitivity range 1 to 5 years.

name: res.decline_oil
justification: Annual exponential post-plateau decline rate for oil projects; requires empirical basin/well data source.

name: res.decline_gas
justification: Annual exponential post-plateau decline rate for gas projects; requires empirical basin/well data source.

name: res.yield_g_soy
justification: Agricultural yield growth rate for soy; family triangular chosen as least informative bounded distribution.

name: res.yield_g_wheat
justification: Agricultural yield growth rate for wheat; family triangular chosen as least informative bounded distribution.

name: res.yield_g_corn
justification: Agricultural yield growth rate for corn; family triangular chosen as least informative bounded distribution.

name: res.va_unit_lithium
justification: Value added per unit of physical production for lithium; requires official sectoral composition and national accounts source.

name: res.va_unit_copper
justification: Value added per unit of physical production for copper; requires official sectoral composition and national accounts source.

name: res.va_unit_gold
justification: Value added per unit of physical production for gold; requires official sectoral composition and national accounts source.

name: res.va_unit_silver
justification: Value added per unit of physical production for silver; requires official sectoral composition and national accounts source.

name: res.va_unit_oil
justification: Value added per unit of physical production for oil; requires official sectoral composition and national accounts source.

name: res.va_unit_gas
justification: Value added per unit of physical production for gas; requires official sectoral composition and national accounts source.

justification: Value added per unit of physical production for soy; requires official sectoral composition and national accounts source.

name: res.va_unit_wheat

name: res.va_unit_corn
justification: Value added per unit of physical production for corn; requires official sectoral composition and national accounts source.

name: res.va_unit_other
justification: Value added per unit of physical production for other resources; requires official sectoral composition and national accounts source.

name: prov.kappa
justification: Damping of intercensal provincial population share drift trend; 0 means constant shares; sensitivity range 0 to 1.

name: ai.delta
justification: Annual TFP growth increment from AI diffusion; drawn between bounds of admissible ai_estimates once populated; family triangular chosen as least informative bounded distribution.

name: ai.lag
justification: Adoption lag over which AI TFP effect ramps up linearly from 0 to 1; sensitivity range 5 to 15 years.
